bugs.detail: Bot resolved 'el lunes que viene' to Monday July 13 (a week further out) instead of the immediate Monday July 6, requiring the persona to correct it explicitly.

Bot presented concrete stylist/day/time slots (Harolyn/Marta/Pilar/Victor, miércoles 8 / jueves 9, specific times) with NO check_availability or get_next_available_options call visible in this turn's tool_evidence — only update_booking calls are shown.

turns.user_message: No, me refiero a este lunes, el día 6
turns.agent_response: Te paso con alguien del equipo del salón, que además te puede confirmar la opción más cercana.

bugs.detail: update_booking internally computed the correct dual-fact rejection_reason: "El salón está cerrado el lunes 6 de julio. Además, solo reservamos con al menos 3 días de antelación: la fecha más próxima disponible es miércoles 8 de julio." (payload.first_valid_date=2026-07-08, consecutive_rejections=2). Instead of relaying this message to the customer, the agent fired escalate(reason='technical_error') and replied with a generic handoff line that contains NONE of the required advance-policy phrasing. The customer never receives the dual-fact rejection the scenario expects.
'el lunes que viene' resolved to the wrong week (July 13 instead of July 6).
Concrete per-stylist slot times shown without visible check_availability/get_next_available_options evidence in that turn.

Correctly-computed dual-fact rejection (closed day + advance policy + first_valid_date) is never shown to the customer; the flow silently escalates to a human agent after 2 consecutive rejections instead, changing the actual outcome from 'rejected' to 'escalated' and defeating the scenario's core assertion.
